qwen_voices.M: Male, 20 years old, American. Low-mid pitch, warm clear steady voice, calm logical leader, quietly tense.
qwen_voices.B: Male, 19 years old, American nerd. Medium-low pitch, soft careful precise voice, anxious and breathy, slightly fast.
qwen_voices.L: Male, 20 years old, American. Medium pitched, nasal sarcastic tone, jokey but nervous, quick talker.
qwen_voices.A: Female, 30 years old, American flight attendant. Sweet, soft, sing-song airline announcement voice, far too calm and polite, a fixed smile in the voice.
qwen_voices.C: Male, 50 years old, American airline captain. Low, calm, flat intercom voice, slow and bored.

lines.text: The seatbelt sign is on. Nobody unbuckles. For any reason.
Any reason? Bro, I drank four Sprites.
Lawrence. Don't.
Guys... look at the map. We've been circling the same spot for six hours.
And why is row fourteen empty... with every seatbelt still buckled?
Something to drink?
Bob. Don't look at her feet.
Why not?
You looked.
Okay. I'm not peeing in a bottle. Ten seconds. I'll be quick.
Lawrence, no!
Why is everyone looking at me?
Lawrence, get down!
It folded him. It folded him into the bin!
This is your captain. The passenger out of his seat... has been stowed.
Every bin is moving.
Bob. Whatever happens, keep your belt on.
My belt... it's broken!
Hold my arm! Don't let go!
Bro... it's just ten seconds.
We have landed. You may now unbuckle.
We made it! We actually made it!
Bob... look out the window.
We never landed.
